title: Voyage au Bout de la Nuit (Journey to the End of the Night)
medium: Oil, acrylic, emulsion and metal on canvas

said.q: Property of an Important European Collector From the Catalogue: Standing almost two metres tall and absorbing the viewer in its vast, variegated surface, Anselm Kiefer’s Voyage au Bout de la Nuit (Journey to the End of the Night) is a monumental canvas from 2004. From a distance, this painting resembles a stellar chart, the constellations marked out by lines linking the various stars.
